capabilities: Fold all content under its heading
Unfold all folds in the note
Assign custom hotkeys to fold commands
extras: README includes developer release instructions (version bump, git tags, artifact attestations); no hotkeys are set by default, so users must assign them manually.
intentEvidence: Fold a note down to its headings, like the code editor shortcut "fold to level N"
problem: Obsidian only folds one heading at a time, so collapsing an entire note to a specific heading level means manually folding each section.

relations.evidence: like the code editor shortcut "fold to level N" (for example Ctrl+K Ctrl+2 in Pulsar / Atom / VS Code)

summary: Adds commands that fold a note down to its headings or to a chosen heading level, mimicking code-editor fold-to-level shortcuts.
